source_board.synthetic_policy: Valid synthetic UART frame flags, zero raw points/doorposition/borderout/count; no physical measurement. Cache refresh is synchronous chosen policy. Natural no-producer modes and injected queue failure retain404 and no appended coordinates.

synthetic_policy.discovery_metadata: UID and peer cid are cached from completed encrypted transactions; plaintext scans reuse them, ignoring scan uid/cid; malformed transactions leave model metadata unchanged

synthetic_policy.synthetic_board_queue_success: r200; source ACK appends borderout,x,y and doorposition when cumulative selector slot>4. synthetic_policy.native_unsafe_door_count: Native accepts uint8 through255 but owns only five door records; the model rejects effective counts>5 and out-of-range cumulative ACK/final UART indices atomically, including configuration-induced mode changes.
synthetic_policy.boundary_cache: Early invalid-border sentinel is [" "] (one space); early reset clears cache to empty string. Late always emits an object; both zero-door lists use [""]. Install1 emits left/right/farthest; install2 right/farthest; other install values only list. Config refresh is synchronous synthetic policy.
synthetic_policy.native_mode_timeouts: Early modes6 and7 and late mode6 have no queue producer, retain r404. Late mode7 saves/queues successfully without appended coordinates.
synthetic_policy.module_management: loginRes requires generic-key selector1; hbok/tm require plaintext selector2, either JSON-string pack or unwrapped. All are silent; loginRes r200 resets heartbeat timer without key replacement. Unwrapped packets retain cached UID/cid. Model validates tm calendar syntax and retains a synthetic module-time input cache; no physical clock/RTOS/cloud-reconnect execution.
synthetic_policy.ota: Source selector0 upgrade routes are assessed; model explicitly rejects atomically, never downloads/flashes or reports a fake success.
synthetic_policy.dump_types: Late dump parses period through numeric-to-float32 scratch and cnt through a uint8 scratch, then discards both. Safe model accepts finite JSON numeric period, bool/int32-or-decimal cnt; neither changes a property or logging configuration.
